events.name: Columbus Blue Jackets at Montreal Canadiens

headlines.description: — Zachary Bolduc scored the winner with his first goal since Dec. 23, and the Montreal Canadiens edged the Columbus Blue Jackets 2-1 on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bolduc scores winner, Canadiens beat Blue Jackets 2-1 for third straight win

headlines.description: — Ben Kindel scored the shootout winner to lead the Pittsburgh Penguins to a 4-3 win over the Ottawa Senators on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Kindel nets shootout winner as Penguins lose Crosby but squeeze past Senators 4-3

events.name: Seattle Kraken at Tampa Bay Lightning

headlines.description: — Brandon Montour scored his second goal of the game 2:47 into overtime to give the Seattle Kraken a 4-3 victory against the Tampa Bay Lightning on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Montour scores in OT to lead Kraken past Lightning 4-3

headlines.description: — Joel Eriksson Ek scored the winning goal with 4.4 seconds left to lift the Minnesota Wild past the Florida Panthers 3-2 on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Wild beat Panthers 3-2 on Joel Eriksson Ek's goal with 4.4 seconds left

events.name: Dallas Stars at New York Islanders

headlines.description: — Ilya Sorokin gave the New York Islanders the type of elite goaltending they needed facing one of the NHL's top teams while in the thick of a...
headlines.shortLinkText: Ilya Sorokin shines against Stars to give the playoff-chasing Islanders a much-needed 2-1 win

headlines.description: — Alex Bump and Sean Couturier scored in the first three minutes of the game and the Philadelphia Flyers used the fast start to cruise to a 5-1 win over the Chicago Blackhawks on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Flyers beat the Blackhawks 5-1 after 2 goals in the first 2:33

events.name: San Jose Sharks at St. Louis Blues

headlines.description: — Dylan Holloway scored with 3 seconds left in overtime to lift the St. Louis Blues to a 2-1 victory over the San Jose Sharks on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Dylan Holloway scores with 3 seconds left in OT as the Blues beat the Sharks 2-1

events.name: New Jersey Devils at Nashville Predators

headlines.description: — Nico Hischier scored two goals to lead the New Jersey Devils to a 4-2 victory over the Nashville Predators on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Hischier scores twice as Devils down Predators 4-2

headlines.description: — Nathan MacKinnon scored his 47th and 48th goals of the season to propel the Colorado Avalanche to a 3-2 victory over the Winnipeg Jets on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: MacKinnon inches closer to 50-goal mark as Avalanche defeat Jets 3-2

headlines.description: — Alex Ovechkin had his 34th career hat trick, Ivan Miroshnichenko scored twice, and the Washington Capitals beat the Utah Mammoth 7-4 on Thursday night to snap a two-game losing streak.
headlines.shortLinkText: Ovechkin's 34th career hat trick powers Capitals past Mammoth, 7-4

headlines.description: — Mikael Granlund capped off his hat trick scoring on the power play with 1 second remaining in overtime on Thursday night to give the Anaheim Ducks a 3-2 victory over the Calgary Flames.
headlines.shortLinkText: Granlund caps hat trick with OT winner as Ducks defeat Flames 3-2

events.name: Edmonton Oilers at Vegas Golden Knights

headlines.description: — Evan Bouchard scored at 3:10 of overtime, shortly after Edmonton killed off a Vegas penalty, and the Oilers defeated the Golden Knights 4-3 in a game Thursday night with playoff implications.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bouchard scores in overtime as Oilers beat Golden Knights 4-3

events.name: Los Angeles Kings at Vancouver Canucks

headlines.description: — Darcy Kuemper made 19 saves for his third shutout of the season and 39th of his career to lead the Los Angeles Kings to a 4-0 victory over the Vancouver Canucks on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Kuemper makes 19 saves in his 39th career shutout as Kings beat Canucks 4-0
